---
title: "Phase 3. Analysis"
description: "Do the work to the design, check it as you go, get it reviewed."
---

## What you do

{{< include /guidance/_partials/step-levels-key.qmd >}}

1. [Every level[:]{.visually-hidden}]{.pb-level} **Collect and prepare the data.** Record each source, its owner and extract date, and
   any known quality issues, with what each means for the answer.
2. [Every level[:]{.visually-hidden}]{.pb-level} **Do the analysis to the design and plan.**
3. [Every level[:]{.visually-hidden}]{.pb-level} **Record your assumptions as you make them:** each one, why it is reasonable, and what
   happens to the answer if it is wrong.
4. [Every level[:]{.visually-hidden}]{.pb-level} **Do your own verification and validation first.** Keep doing both throughout, in proportion
   to the work. See [what verification and validation mean](../09-resources/r1-glossary.qmd#s-to-z).
5. [From Level 2[:]{.visually-hidden}]{.pb-level} **Keep a quality assurance log** of what you checked, when, and what you found.
6. [From Level 2[:]{.visually-hidden}]{.pb-level} **Document the uncertainty in the results:** where it comes from and how large it is. From
   Level 3, quantify it wherever the method allows. See
   [uncertainty, assumptions and limitations](../09-resources/r10-uncertainty.qmd) for how.
7. [Every level[:]{.visually-hidden}]{.pb-level} **Hand the analysis to your critical friend**, who runs
   [the checks the level asks for](../07-deciding-your-assurance-level/what-your-level-requires.qmd#the-checks-by-level)
   and reports back. Act on their findings.
8. [From Level 2[:]{.visually-hidden}]{.pb-level} **Log decisions, assumption changes and any departure from the plan as you make them.**

## Records to keep

- Complete as much of the project record as your level asks for. See
  [what to record at each level](../07-deciding-your-assurance-level/what-your-level-requires.qmd#what-to-record).
- Where your analysis involves code, see the
  [NHSBSA Analytical Code Assurance Playbook](https://nhsbsa-data-analytics.github.io/nhsbsa-analytical-code-assurance-playbook)
  for version control, testing, peer review and documentation.

## Outputs of this phase

- [Every level[:]{.visually-hidden}]{.pb-level} The data sources and assumptions, recorded in the project record.
- [From Level 2[:]{.visually-hidden}]{.pb-level} The quality assurance log: what was checked, when, and what was found.
- [From Level 2[:]{.visually-hidden}]{.pb-level} The uncertainty, documented, and quantified from Level 3 where the method allows.
- [From Level 2[:]{.visually-hidden}]{.pb-level} The decision log, including anything that changed and why.
- Your critical friend's findings, and what you did about each one.
- Technical documentation that lets somebody else re-run the work.

## Ready for Phase 4 when

- The checks the level asks for have been done, by you and by your critical friend.
- Their findings have been acted on, or answered.
- The log says what was checked rather than what was planned.

  assumptions you log as you go

## Who does what in this phase

| Role | In Phase 3 |
|---|---|
| **Analyst** | Do the work and your own checks first. Log decisions and assumption changes as you make them |
| **Critical friend** | Run the checks the level asks for. Report errors and improvements back |
| **Commissioner** | Stay available. Review any change of design or method. Resist changing the question late |
| **Analysis Senior Responsible Officer** | Business Critical work only. Stay aware of progress, and be available to approve at delivery |
